:::{#rem-negate-quantifiers}
#### Why the two laws share a theorem

The two laws in [De Morgan's laws for quantifiers](#thm-negate-quantifiers)
are one rule seen from each side:
negating a [quantifier](#def-quantifier) swaps $\forall$ and $\exists$
and moves the [negation](#def-not) onto the [predicate](#def-predicate).
[De Morgan's laws for propositions](#thm-de-morgan-logic) pair their two laws the same way,
and these laws extend them from two propositions to a whole [set](#def-set) of them.

:::
